description: This file defines an Angular component 'ReadingsPageComponent' responsible for managing and displaying readings data for manufacturing equipment. It handles loading equipment data, fetching readings, managing form state, and submitting new readings via an API service.

classes.name: ReadingsPageComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing and displaying equipment readings, including form handling, data fetching, and submission.

methods.name: loadEquipment
methods.description: Loads equipment list from API and initializes the form with the first equipment's ID if not set.

methods.name: refreshReadings
methods.description: Fetches the list of readings, optionally filtered by selected equipment.

methods.name: parseOptionalNumber
methods.description: Converts raw input to a number or undefined, handling empty or invalid input.

methods.name: onEquipmentChange
methods.description: Updates form state when equipment selection changes.

methods.name: onTimestampChange
methods.description: Updates form state when timestamp input changes.

methods.name: onNotesChange
methods.description: Updates form state when notes input changes.

methods.name: onTemperatureChange
methods.description: Updates form temperature field after parsing input.

methods.name: onVibrationChange
methods.description: Updates form vibration field after parsing input.

methods.name: onRuntimeChange
methods.description: Updates form runtime hours field after parsing input.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits the current form data as a new reading via API and resets relevant fields.
